catalogue.title: Overseas Trade Statistics API (uktradeinfo)
catalogue.notes: Monthly UK imports by CN8 commodity and recorded partner. Partner = country of dispatch, which may differ from where goods were grown. Imports valued CIF (statistical value; Intrastat EU trade uses invoice value). Net mass in kg; about a third of Intrastat goods need no weight declaration and are estimated. Provisional for up to 18 months after publication. Series breaks: EU exit (Jan 2021) and customs-based GB–EU import collection (Jan 2022).
